en:
Welcome to the Data Room.
Here you can check our club's results
and other information.

Check information on our club's
players and on other clubs.

View the records of the J.League
and the Japan National Team.

See rankings of top players in the
J.League and around the world.

Check every J.League club's results
this year, and the year-by-year trend
in final standings.

Check the current rankings of nations
worldwide and Japan's year-by-year
ranking trend.

See how our club ranks against clubs
around the world, and the rankings
of the world's clubs.

Check our results in the tournaments
we have entered. If we have won one,
you can admire the trophy here.
The greatest records set in J1 so far.

Check the current results of all J1
and J2 clubs this year, and how they
have changed.

Check the trend in final results for
all J1 and J2 clubs.

Check the glorious, unbroken records
set by J1 clubs.

Check the unbroken, dishonourable
records set by J1 clubs.

Check the glorious, unbroken records
set by J1 players.

Our J.League results by year since
joining will appear here. Please wait
until this year's league has finished.

This year's J2 and J1 results will
appear here. Please wait until the
first J2 match of the year is over.

Check the yearly J1 goalscoring
rankings.

Check the yearly J2 goalscoring
rankings.

Rankings by position, covering
players all over the world.

Check the goalkeeper rankings for
players worldwide.

Check the defender rankings for
players worldwide.

Check the midfielder rankings for
players worldwide.

Check the forward rankings for
players worldwide.

Please check back after this year's
J1 opening match.

There is no J2 goalscoring data yet.
Please check back after this year's
J2 opening match.

Information about our club's players
and the club rules.

Information on the other clubs in
the J.League.

Information on the current
national teams.

Players who contributed greatly to
our club and the J.League and have
been inducted into the Hall of Fame.

#sname#, these are the rules for
running this club as its
representative.

Check the players selected for
national teams.

Check your goals as manager of
the Japan National Team.

When a national tournament is on, you
can see the squads of each nation.
There's no tournament now, so no data.

Our club is 1st with @Y/#tk00# wins@
in a row. Well played, but this streak
won't stand forever.

Our club leads with @Y/#tk01# titles@.
But bask in the glory and a club on a
roll will overtake us.

Our club leads with @Y/#tk02# times@.
But a club with a fine defence will
beat that figure sooner or later.

Our club is 1st with @Y/#tk04# goals@.
But a total like this is bound to be
beaten before long.

Our club is last on @M/#tk05# goals@.
Let's use this as motivation to boost
our scoring power.

Our club is last with @M/#tk06# goals
conceded@. Let's use that to tighten up
at the back.

We have @M/#tk07# losses@, the worst.
Let's take this disappointment and
vow to come back stronger.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their scoring power was
greatly feared by other clubs.

The current top two are both our
players. Having J1's two best scorers
at our club is reassuring.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their scoring power was
famous throughout J1.

The current top two are both our
players. Having J2's two best scorers
at our club is reassuring.

What a year! Our @Y/%s@ was named
the world's number one "Iron Wall".
A memorable year indeed.

Right now @Y/%s@ is in first place.
I'd love to see how many goals they
can keep out against the world's best.

That year's top two were both our
players. Even the world's best would
have struggled to score against them.

The current top two are both our
players. Even world-class clubs would
find it hard to score against them.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their control of matches was
praised around the world.

The current top two are both our
players. Even world-class clubs will
struggle to dictate matches.

That year's top two were both our
players. Their scoring power could
threaten any defence in the world.

The current top two are both our
players. They look set to bag plenty
of goals against the world's best.

A list of the players at our club.
Up/Down: select a player.
A Button: view their details.

A player at our club.
Press the A Button to see this
player's evaluation.

View Hall of Fame players by position.
Left/Right: select. A Button: confirm.

This is @Y/%s@.
A GK who was a wall for our club and
earned a place in the Hall of Fame.

This is @Y/%s@.
A defender who kept opponents out and
earned a place in the Hall of Fame.

This is @Y/%s@.
A midfielder who shaped matches in our
favour, earning a Hall of Fame place.

This is @Y/%s@.
A forward who scored freely against
rivals, earning a Hall of Fame place.

No GK from our club is in the Hall of
Fame yet. I hope one comes along soon
who can keep out any shot.

No defender from our club is in the
Hall of Fame yet. We need one soon who
can reliably stop opposing attacks.

No midfielder from our club is in the
Hall of Fame yet. We need a star of
the midfield battle to emerge soon.

No forward from our club is in the
Hall of Fame yet. I hope a prolific
scorer emerges soon.

These are the minimum rules you must
keep. If you break any of the three
items above, you can't run the club.

Our club has only @M/%D players@ who
can play. Be careful, or we could be
unable to play in official matches.

Club management is in a very tough
situation. If we don't improve soon,
things will get serious.

Here are your targets as Japan
Manager. If you miss them, #sname#,
you will be forced to resign.

Choose the club you want to view.
Select its flag and press the A Button
to see its information.

Information on this club's players.
Up/Down: switch to another player.
Left/Right: switch to another club.

Choose the national team to view.
Select a flag and press the A Button
to switch to that nation's squad.

Information on this team's players.
Up/Down: switch to another player.
Left/Right: switch to another team.

The latest transfers of players
around the world.

Recent transfers around the world,
but none have been especially notable.

Check our results in every tournament
we have entered. Use the D-pad to
select a cup and press the A Button.

The #tk11# trophy. Seeing it again
really brings home the win.

The trophies from each tournament are
lined up here. Let's work hard to
collect them all.

=W/The longest winning streak in a year
is ours. Our own record, but what a
run of wins!=

The longest winning streak in a year
belongs to @Y/#tk00#@. A rival, but a
remarkable record.

=W/The longest clean-sheet run in a year
is ours. It shows how iron-strong our
defence is.=

=W/The fewest goals conceded in a year
is ours. A superb record showing the
defence's fighting spirit.=

The fewest goals conceded in a year
was set by @Y/#tk02#@. Their defence
is superb, even as opponents.

=W/The most goals scored in a year is
ours. This total is the pride of our
attacking line.=

The most goals scored in a year is
held by @Y/#tk03#@. Enough to frighten
any opponent.

=K/The fewest goals scored in a year is
ours, I'm afraid. Opposing defences
may well take us lightly...=

The fewest goals scored in a year was
set by @R/#tk04#@. They hardly seem a
threat to face, by the look of it.

=K/The most goals conceded in a year is
ours, I'm afraid. Do they think our
defence leaks like a sieve?=

The most goals conceded in a year was
set by @R/#tk05#@. You could score on
them whenever you liked, it seems.

=K/The longest losing streak in a year
is ours, I'm afraid. On this record
alone we look like a weak club...=

The longest losing streak in a year
was set by @R/#tk06#@. It might make
them look like a weak club.

Goals scored in the worst per-match
attacking record: @R/Red Diamonds@ hold this
unwanted record with @R/26@ goals.

Goals conceded in the worst per-match
defensive record: @R/Vissel Kobe@ hold this
unwanted record with @R/89@ goals against.

=W/Our club's @Y/#tk07#@ is top of the
J1 goalscoring rankings. The pride of
our attacking line.=

=W/Our club has a player in the J1
goalscoring rankings. A player with
great scoring power.=

The J1 goalscoring rankings.
In first place is @Y/#tk07#@, a player
with superb scoring power.

J2 goalscoring rankings. Scoring power
good enough for J1 as well.=

goalscoring rankings. A player with
great scoring power.=

The J2 goalscoring rankings.
In first place is @Y/#tk07#@, a player
good enough to score in J1 too.

=W/Our club's @Y/#tk09#@ has taken first
place in the world goalkeeper rankings
with brilliant saves.=

=W/We have a player in the world GK
rankings. Producing a player who can
compete worldwide is our club's pride.=

=W/Our club's @Y/#tk10#@ has taken first
place in the world defender rankings
with superb defending.=

=W/We have a player in the world DF
rankings. Producing a player who can
compete worldwide is our club's pride.=

=W/Our club's @Y/#tk11#@ has been superb
at both ends of the pitch and now tops
the World MF Ranking.=

=W/Our players have made the World MF
Ranking. Having players who can compete
worldwide is something to be proud of.=

=W/Our club's @Y/#tk12#@ has shown
incredible scoring power and now tops
the World FW Ranking.=

=W/Our players have made the World FW
Ranking. Having players who can compete
worldwide is something to be proud of.=

Club management and results are both
fine. Keep striving to go even higher!

official matches, so you won't be able
to play. Please scout some more.

won't be able to carry on. Please keep
spending to a minimum.

your ability as manager. Review your
players, training and tactics.

The club is in a terrible state.
Let's fix the problems one by one,
and quickly.
